cline-397039574.oneLine: Adds About page with release notes and update controls
cline-397039574.summary: Settings gains an About page with version, update buttons and recent release notes, plus a one-time What's new dialog after updates.

codex-397006677.summary: Patch release; changelog details could not be determined from the PR index or tag comparison.

claude-code-396845205.oneLine: Adds deniedModels and availableModelsMatch managed settings
claude-code-396845205.summary: Adds managed settings to pin or block model versions, a /doctor prompt-audit command, and fixes MCP and SDK session issues.

cline-396471066.oneLine: Fixes startup failures behind system HTTP proxies
cline-396471066.summary: Local connection checks now skip system proxies so the app starts behind Clash or corporate proxies, and oversized windows shrink to fit.

codex-396234532.oneLine: Adds GPT-6 Sol and Luna models with Amazon Bedrock support
codex-396234532.summary: Adds GPT-6 Sol and Luna, turns on fullscreen transcripts by default, and auto-starts background servers for eligible interactive sessions.

claude-code-395840120.oneLine: Adds maxProseWidth setting for wide terminals
claude-code-395840120.summary: Adds a setting capping prose width in wide terminals and fixes resumed sessions dropping extended thinking or failing on redacted_thinking.

cline-395862160.oneLine: Adds ai& provider and refreshes catalog to 6,386 models
cline-395862160.summary: Adds the ai& provider, refreshes the catalog to 6,386 models with new defaults for 19 unpinned providers, and bumps js-yaml for a security fix.

hermes-agent-395553114.oneLine: Patch tag rolling up ~460 PRs since v0.21.4
hermes-agent-395553114.summary: Stable tag for Docker and hosted deployments adding a Desktop plugin SDK wave, a Connectors page and localized catalogs; notes deferred to v0.22.0.

cline-395484237.oneLine: Cline Desktop now ships Linux .deb and .rpm packages
cline-395484237.summary: Desktop gains Linux x64 packages, working plugin slash commands, a diagnostics export and restored streaming voice input with provider transcription.

cline-395373268.oneLine: Recovers local-model runs that hit the output-token limit
cline-395373268.summary: The CLI compacts and retries turns truncated by local-model output limits, explains hub startup failures, and keeps session errors across resume.

cline-395367139.oneLine: SDK retries turns truncated at the output-token limit
cline-395367139.summary: Truncated text-only turns get a compact-and-retry attempt, hub startup errors carry their cause, and session renames made via the hub persist.

gemini-cli-395156363.oneLine: Hardens sandbox boundaries and blocks indirect prompt injection
gemini-cli-395156363.summary: Fixes prompt injection via build file changes and untrusted flags, hardens sandbox filesystem boundaries, and preserves explicit Flash model IDs.

claude-code-394877414.oneLine: Adds Bedrock assume_role and guardrails to the gateway
claude-code-394877414.summary: The Claude apps gateway gains Bedrock assume_role and guardrail support, desktop policy controls, and settings.json attribution:false handling.

goose-394774549.oneLine: Adds live voice conversations in the desktop app
goose-394774549.summary: Adds live voice conversations, a Z.AI Coding Plan provider, Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 model support, plus recipe parameter limits and many fixes.

cline-394122733.oneLine: Loads all Composio connector tools instead of the first 20
cline-394122733.summary: Composio connectors fetch their full tool list, Mac-to-Mac SSH remotes now work, and session errors persist in the transcript across clients.

cline-394105689.oneLine: Runs same-step sub-agent tool calls in parallel
cline-394105689.summary: Sub-agents spawned together now run tool calls concurrently, the default output budget scales with model limits, and hook context injection works again.

claude-code-393879189.oneLine: Adds Claude Opus 5.5 as the default Opus model
claude-code-393879189.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 with 1M context becomes the default Opus model; also adds fullscreen mouse support and fixes auto mode retry loops.

cline-393553443.oneLine: Retries turns that hit the output-token limit without a tool call
cline-393553443.summary: Runs hitting max-tokens without a usable tool call retry up to three times, and the default output allowance scales with the model's advertised limit.

cline-393435429.oneLine: Run-start hooks can inject context via beforeRun
cline-393435429.summary: beforeRun hooks can append context behind an opt-in flag, feature-flag polls are deduplicated, and Windows no longer runs workspace-local binaries first.

opencode-393337379.oneLine: Fixes Bedrock image hoisting and Together AI usage reporting
opencode-393337379.summary: Bedrock image attachments are hoisted only for Claude, Nova and Llama 4 models, and Together AI streaming usage reporting is fixed.

hermes-agent-393186039.oneLine: Patch rollup of ~1,800 PRs adding CLI stream-json output
hermes-agent-393186039.summary: Stable tag rolling up ~1,800 PRs, adding stream-json CLI output, skill auto-load, a connector setup card and a dozen new catalog plugins.

crush-393113428.oneLine: Breaking: renames theme keys insert_bg and delete_bg
crush-393113428.summary: Theme API renames insert_bg to insert_code_bg and delete_bg to delete_code_bg and prefixes diff keys with diff_, so theme files need updating.

crush-392818179.oneLine: Adds themes with live preview and custom palettes
crush-392818179.summary: Crush gains a Themes dialog with live preview and in-TUI custom palettes, real-time hypercredit display, and fixes for wrapping and highlighting.

claude-code-391877760.oneLine: Auto mode defaults to the server-side classifier
claude-code-391877760.summary: Auto mode on the Claude API, Enterprise, Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways now defaults to the unbilled server-side classifier.

claude-code-391616593.oneLine: Adds AGENTS.md support when a project has no CLAUDE.md
claude-code-391616593.summary: Claude Code reads AGENTS.md as project instructions when no CLAUDE.md exists; also adds gateway proxy options and fixes print-mode hangs.

claude-code-391158184.oneLine: Fixes 400 errors behind proxies from the 2.1.275 regression
claude-code-391158184.summary: Fixes every request failing with a 400 Input tag error when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points at a proxy or gateway, a regression from 2.1.275.

claude-code-391032307.oneLine: Syncs claude.ai skills and plugins into terminal sessions
claude-code-391032307.summary: Adds claude.ai skill and plugin syncing, a ctrl+enter send-now key and gateway sign-in account confirmation, and fixes prompt cache misses.

goose-390993172.oneLine: Adds GPT-live API support and an opt-in terminal bell
goose-390993172.summary: Adds GPT-live API support, an operator allowlist for gateway pairing and an opt-in terminal bell, with fixes for streamed thinking order.

claude-code-390317660.oneLine: Fixes MCP timeouts, SSE fallbacks and stuck retry loops
claude-code-390317660.summary: Fixes Streamable HTTP MCP calls timing out at five minutes, legacy SSE servers failing to connect, and sessions stuck retrying tool_use_id errors.

crush-389810994.oneLine: Adds Plan Mode, activated with shift+tab
crush-389810994.summary: Plan Mode lets you talk through a plan with the agent before executing, activated with shift+tab, alongside database and UI performance work.

claude-code-389362239.oneLine: Adds gateway hint headers and remote-control session forking
claude-code-389362239.summary: Adds opt-in gateway hint request headers, forking remote-control sessions from the Claude app, and fixes permission bypasses and managed-setting overrides.

goose-388709907.oneLine: Reverts model updates and MCP version selection change
goose-388709907.summary: Patch release that reverts the model updates and the MCP default version selection change shipped in v1.50.0.

opencode-388581987.oneLine: Restores ACP session settings when resuming or forking
opencode-388581987.summary: ACP sessions keep their model, effort, mode and reasoning boundaries when loaded, resumed or forked; the TUI reports remote config auth errors.

hermes-agent-388531783.oneLine: Fixes remote sessions expiring on refresh bursts
hermes-agent-388531783.summary: Patch tag so remote gateway sign-in fixes reach Cloud agents: refresh bursts no longer revoke sessions and duplicate state.db writer handles stop leaking.

crush-388407199.oneLine: Fixes OpenAI-compatible regression on stopped turns
crush-388407199.summary: Hotfix for a regression on OpenAI-compatible endpoints when a turn is stopped partway through, plus a path-boundary fix for tilde expansion.

crush-387421289.oneLine: Adds ChatGPT subscription sign-in and --reasoning-effort flag
crush-387421289.summary: Crush can use your ChatGPT subscription via OAuth, headless crush run takes --reasoning-effort, and scrolling and spinner performance improved.

hermes-agent-387280867.oneLine: Fixes the state.db corruption class introduced in v0.21.0
hermes-agent-387280867.summary: Six PRs close the state.db reliability problems from v0.21.0: no more second writers, healthy WAL databases stop wedging, FTS errors stop killing turns.

crush-385848265.oneLine: Adds an option to disable mouse support
crush-385848265.summary: Mouse support can be turned off in config or the command palette; also validates images for non-vision models and fixes Copilot and OpenCode endpoints.

opencode-385202354.oneLine: Adds Astra system prompt for GPT-6 models
opencode-385202354.summary: Adds the Astra system prompt for GPT-6 models, preserves Bedrock DeepSeek IDs, and adds reasoning effort variants for GitLab GPT and Claude models.

goose-385009622.oneLine: Adds GPT-6 Astra; removes fast model routing
goose-385009622.summary: Adds GPT-6 Astra models and tool calling for goose-agent, and removes fast model routing, the local-inference model registry and the keyring timeout.

hermes-agent-384339710.oneLine: Patch rollup of main since v0.21.0
hermes-agent-384339710.summary: Stable tag rolling up modularization, startup performance, MCP authorization, cron and delegation fixes since v0.21.0; notes deferred to v0.22.0.

opencode-383062420.oneLine: Fixes GPT-6 models missing for OpenAI subscription users
opencode-383062420.summary: Codex OAuth model filtering now recognizes integer GPT versions like gpt-6, so gpt-6-astra shows up for OpenAI subscription users.

opencode-382479085.oneLine: Sends session ID as GitHub Copilot interaction header
opencode-382479085.summary: Copilot requests now carry the session ID interaction header, and desktop device auth uses the desktop client ID with a larger open-in-app icon.

goose-382282720.oneLine: Adds desktop auto-updater and Linux ARM64 packages
goose-382282720.summary: Desktop gains an auto-updater and ARM64 packages, extensions load in the background so the CLI prompt is ready immediately, plus web-search and browser skills.

opencode-381579653.oneLine: Defaults provider and chunk timeouts to five minutes
opencode-381579653.summary: Provider and streamed-chunk timeouts now default to five minutes so slow model startups fail less often, and Anthropic thinking binding can be opted out.

opencode-380823834.oneLine: Makes Claude 5 sessions tolerate stale thinking blocks
opencode-380823834.summary: Claude 5 sessions no longer fail after prompt or tool changes, Bedrock GPT-5.6 accepts none reasoning effort, and desktop renames save reliably.

crush-380045000.oneLine: Adds a configurable compact exit banner option
crush-380045000.summary: The exit banner can be set to compact or hidden in crushrc or crush.json, alongside Fantasy inference fixes and a swapped cache price config fix.

hermes-agent-379999964.oneLine: Ships Bot Mode with group chats and bot-to-bot DMs
hermes-agent-379999964.summary: v0.21.0 bundles Bot Mode into the desktop app with named agents and group chats, adds hermes peer bot-to-bot DMs, and gives cron jobs memory.

opencode-378279694.oneLine: Fixes Azure CLI sign-in working without Bun
opencode-378279694.summary: Azure authentication now works with Azure CLI sign-in without requiring Bun.

opencode-378250041.oneLine: Adds Microsoft Entra ID sign-in for Azure providers
opencode-378250041.summary: Azure providers can sign in with Entra ID through the Azure CLI instead of an API key; Bedrock reasoning responses no longer cache as empty messages.

goose-378063290.oneLine: Adds six declarative providers including OpenCode Zen
goose-378063290.summary: Adds TrustedRouter, OpenCode Zen, Gondola, SayGM, Lynkr and PleumRouter providers, custom provider cost tracking, and GPT-5.6 routing via Bedrock.

hermes-agent-377790585.oneLine: Adds real-profile browsing and a 50+ remote MCP catalog
hermes-agent-377790585.summary: Rollup of ~525 PRs adding consent-gated default-profile browsing, a 50+ verified remote MCP catalog, OS-keychain secret encryption and lean-tail compression.

crush-377284485.oneLine: Fixes GitHub MCP with automatic sessionless mode
crush-377284485.summary: GitHub MCP works again via automatic sessionless mode, code indentation is fixed in previews and markdown, and three Qwen3.8 models join Hyper.

crush-376688444.oneLine: Fixes MCP reliability and ctrl+a selection
crush-376688444.summary: Improves handling of misconfigured MCP servers, repairs ctrl+a after v0.91.0, and fixes copy selection with wrapped lines.

opencode-376179421.oneLine: Fixes Cloudflare AI Gateway routing for third-party models
opencode-376179421.summary: Non-Workers models now route via the gateway REST API and Anthropic dashed slugs convert correctly; GitHub OIDC auth is also fixed.

goose-374587883.oneLine: Adds git branch indicator and recent-model picker
goose-374587883.summary: Adds an interactive git branch indicator, recent models in the footer picker and pre-registered OAuth clients; fixes recipe validation and OAuth transport.

hermes-agent-374377893.oneLine: Adds keyless web tier and Bot Mode group-room threads
hermes-agent-374377893.summary: Rollup of ~323 PRs adding Bot Mode group threads with attachments, a keyless web tier with free model rotation, CLI polish and per-job cron memory.

hermes-agent-372160932.oneLine: Adds desktop glass themes and a tabbed Sessions/Bots sidebar
hermes-agent-372160932.summary: Rollup of ~74 PRs adding glass and translucency surfaces, a tabbed Sessions and Bots sidebar, skill install security scanning and cron media hardening.

hermes-agent-371876201.oneLine: Migrates to the MCP 2.x SDK with stateless protocol support
hermes-agent-371876201.summary: Rollup of ~125 PRs bringing the MCP 2.x SDK and 2026-07-28 stateless protocol support, the bundled Bot Mode plugin, and cron scheduler self-healing.

goose-369368159.oneLine: Adds per-message usage stats and streaming shell output
goose-369368159.summary: Adds per-message token, cost and latency stats, streaming shell output, cache-safe request assembly and an unrolled agent loop.

goose-362024365.oneLine: Adds latest Gemini models and structured compaction summaries
goose-362024365.summary: Adds latest Gemini model support, structured compaction summaries and model command tab completion, and fixes dynamic model discovery and Grok support.

goose-358902599.oneLine: Fixes arbitrary command execution in goose review (GHSA)
goose-358902599.summary: Patches arbitrary command execution in goose review via git core.fsmonitor config, and adds GPT-5.6, latest Gemini models and more desktop locales.

aider-238790002.oneLine: Adds support for all GPT-5 models and Grok-4
aider-238790002.summary: Adds GPT-5, Grok-4, Kimi K2 and Gemini flash-lite model support; /clear confirms it worked and /undo output shows only the first line.

aider-228491827.oneLine: Adds Gemini 2.5 and Responses API models like o3-pro
aider-228491827.summary: Adds Gemini 2.5 and o3-pro models with thinking token controls, makes Co-authored-by attribution the default, and adds --commit-language.

opencode-ai-228252352.oneLine: Fixes early return handling for Ollama
opencode-ai-228252352.summary: Fixes an early return path when using Ollama.

opencode-ai-227814261.summary: Adds GitHub Copilot as a provider, with README updates.

opencode-ai-223781679.oneLine: Prevents empty parts in Gemini assistant messages
opencode-ai-223781679.summary: Gemini no longer sends empty parts in assistant messages; the Anthropic SDK is upgraded to v1.4.0 with provider updates.

opencode-ai-223106128.summary: Adds the free DeepSeek model on OpenRouter.

opencode-ai-223069490.summary: README updates and Gemini provider tweaks.

aider-222180237.oneLine: Adds Claude Sonnet 4 and Opus 4 model support
aider-222180237.summary: Adds Claude Sonnet 4 and Opus 4 plus Gemini 2.5 flash preview support, updates the sonnet and opus aliases, and adds shell tab completion.

opencode-ai-220460162.summary: Adds a local provider and switches to the provided logging package.

opencode-ai-220193445.oneLine: Adds non-interactive mode, VertexAI and path completion
opencode-ai-220193445.summary: Adds non-interactive mode, VertexAI support, file path completion, named custom command arguments and persisted model selections.

opencode-ai-218677609.summary: Updates the Arch User Repository packaging.

aider-217725361.oneLine: Adds Gemini 2.5 Pro preview, qwen3 and OCaml repo maps
aider-217725361.summary: Adds gemini-2.5-pro-preview-05-06 and qwen3-235b models, OCaml repo maps, shell completions and a --disable-playwright flag.

aider-212339053.oneLine: Adds GPT-4.1, Grok-3 and new patch and editor edit formats
aider-212339053.summary: Adds GPT-4.1 mini and nano and Grok-3 models plus the patch, editor-diff and editor-whole edit formats, with architect mode fixes.

aider-210314163.oneLine: Adds quasar-alpha model and OpenRouter OAuth prompts
aider-210314163.summary: Adds the free openrouter/quasar-alpha model, offers OpenRouter OAuth when a key is missing, and stops retrying calls with insufficient credits.

aider-209238246.oneLine: Adds OpenRouter OAuth and smarter default model selection
aider-209238246.summary: Adds OpenRouter OAuth onboarding and picks Gemini 2.5 Pro defaults when its keys are set; also validates color settings and adds Scala repo maps.

aider-208244032.oneLine: Adds Gemini 2.5 Pro, DeepSeek V3 and the /context command
aider-208244032.summary: Adds Gemini 2.5 Pro and DeepSeek V3 0324 support, a /context command that finds files to edit, and overeager mode for Claude 3.7 Sonnet.

aider-207521806.summary: Adds commands to switch editor and weak models, validates unsupported reasoning settings, and supports AWS_PROFILE for Bedrock models.

aider-205707771.oneLine: Adopts tree-sitter-language-pack for 130 more linter languages
aider-205707771.summary: Adopts tree-sitter-language-pack adding 130 linter and 20 repo-map languages, plus /think-tokens and /reasoning-effort commands.
